sceneConcept: A provisional design for an ordinary twenty-nine-year-old Chinese field sampling worker stands alone against a transparent background. Short black hair, brown eyes and a narrow tired face make him look like a forgettable low-level executor. He wears an unmarked grey-blue field jacket over a compact slate utility vest, dark cargo trousers, work gloves, a utility belt and plain work boots. Both hands hold a closed rugged grey sampling unit at waist height while he looks down at its simple circular status lamps. One small transparent cartridge window is built into the case. Soft even frontal studio light keeps the equipment practical. Visual refresh: numbered sampling gear built from a utility vest, sealed pouches and snap-fit buckles.
